note: Screens and operations used by the scenarios that are not in the contract or the screen catalogue of this branch, with the lane that builds them (none are left except the installed-application screens, built outside the catalogue). `scenario.mjs check --strict` turns each entry still missing into an error; run it before the recording starts. Entries marked status built exist in the application but outside the screen catalogue. `lanes` lists the lanes that scenes wait for (`requires` of a scene): a scene with a lane that is not `merged` is accepted by the checks, left out of a recording (use --include-pending to force it) and reported as waiting; flip the lane to `merged` when it is on main, then the scene is recorded and checked as any other. A screen entry with status `planned` and no catalogue row is a screen that a pending lane will add; the recording agent binds its real id at merge.
